snip.t: Erysipelas: infection confined to the upper dermis and superficial lymphatics; borders are sharply demarcated and raised, with intense, well-defined redness
snip.s: Bacteriology & Medical Entomology Exam — Short Answer Questions

snip.t: Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A): Non‑purulent cellulitis, erysipelas — Crowded living conditions, lymphatic obstruction
| Erysipelas | Sharply demarcated raised erythema, often on face/legs | Upper dermal involvement, raised borders |
Clinical manifestations: pharyngitis, impetigo/cellulitis/erysipelas, scarlet fever, necrotizing fasciitis, streptococcal toxic shock syndrome, post-infectious rheumatic fever/glomerulonephritis.
